rulesStrings.li: crossed_origin->The first confirmed Marked Virus cluster began as a blood-screening anomaly in a frontier hospital. Within four days the hospital staff were armed, organized, and hunting survivors by name.
crossed_military_report->Military Report 17: Do not classify infected as undead. Subjects retain door use, weapon use, ambush planning, and speech. Treat every infected human as an armed combatant.
crossed_survivor_journal->Survivor Journal: The worst part was the laughing. They remembered the hallways. They remembered the locks. They remembered us.
crossed_audio_log->Audio Log C-44: Marked rash is most visible around the eyes and cheeks. Advanced cases show a dark red X pattern across the face, neck, and upper torso.
crossed_progression->Medical Note: Most confirmed victims resolve quickly. A terminal case usually becomes one of the Marked Men or dies from viral collapse; rare slow infections remain lucid longer.
crossed_timeline->Planetary Timeline: Exposure. Rapid onset. Psychosis. Transformation. Organized raids. Settlement collapse. Alpha migration.

crossed_pack_structure->Field Note: The pack is not a single mind. Its members retain scraps of old loyalties and skills, but rank is enforced through fear and usefulness. An Alpha can direct a hunt; remove that leader and the pack may scatter, hesitate, or erupt into a reckless charge.

crossed_roles->Quartermaster's Ledger: The infected adapt their tools to the job. Watchers carry light gear and range ahead, Pursuers track isolated prey, Gunners cover open ground, and Breakers wear whatever protection can survive a breach. Their equipment is scavenged, repaired, and taken from the fallen.

crossed_memory->Recovered Letter: I heard one of them call another by a childhood nickname. Then they laughed and dragged him back into the fight. I do not know whether the memory made them more human or only made the violence harder to watch.

crossed_temporary_service->Quarantine Addendum: A transformed captive may obey a stronger pack without belonging to it. Treat cooperation as borrowed time, not trust. When the bond ends, the old loyalties are gone and the new ones may be gone too.

crossed_outpost->Settlement Survey: The Marked Men do not need a capital to hold ground. A barricaded workshop, a guarded food store, and a clear line of retreat are enough to turn a ruin into a foothold. They build where the next hunt can begin.

crossed_survival->Field Manual: Do not assume a quiet infected pawn is harmless, and do not assume a loud pack is disorganized. Watch their spacing, their weapons, and who the others follow. The first target is often the one no one is looking at.
